title: Mars 2020 single-frame filename
reference: M2020 Camera Data Products SIS (JPL D-99960), Table 18-1

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: Camera that acquired the product.

segments.label: Color / filter
segments.description: Colour space band, filter position or illumination state.

values.D: Lower green Bayer cells (G2), or PIXL dense SLI-A illumination
values.R: RGB band 1 (red), or PIXL red LEDs
values.G: RGB band 2 (green), or PIXL green LEDs
values.B: RGB band 3 (blue), or PIXL blue LEDs
values.S: HSI band 2 (saturation), or PIXL sparse SLI-B illumination
values.0: Mastcam-Z filter 0, or SHERLOC cover closed with LEDs off
values.1: Mastcam-Z filter 1, or SHERLOC cover open with LEDs off
values.2: Mastcam-Z filter 2, or SHERLOC cover closed with LEDs on
values.3: Mastcam-Z filter 3, or SHERLOC cover open with LEDs on

segments.label: Special processing
segments.description: Marks off-nominal processing; the meaning of each letter is assigned per sol. EDRs are always "_".

segments.label: Sol
segments.description: Primary timestamp. On the surface this is the Mars solar day; in cruise and ground test it is an encoded Earth year and day-of-year instead.

segments.label: Venue
segments.description: Where the data came from.

segments.label: Spacecraft clock
segments.description: Secondary timestamp: whole seconds of the spacecraft clock at the start of the observation (Earth-received time in ground tests where the clock resets).

segments.label: Separator
segments.description: Underscore for readability. On single-frame meshes it carries the mesh geometry code instead.

segments.label: Milliseconds
segments.description: Milliseconds of the spacecraft clock or UTC timestamp.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: What kind of product this is — raw EDR, decompanded, radiometrically corrected, geometry, and so on.

values.ECM: EDR — original companded image, as downlinked
values.ECV: EDR — single frame of a video sequence
values.EID: EDR — image data product header only
values.FDR: FDR — full data record, reassembled image

segments.label: Geometry
segments.description: Whether the image has been geometrically linearized. All EDRs are raw geometry.

values._: Raw geometry, not linearized (CacheCam: mirror-flipped to natural view)
values.L: Linearized against its actual stereo partner

segments.label: Thumbnail
segments.description: Thumbnail flag.

values.N: Full frame, sub-frame or downsampled — not a thumbnail

segments.label: Site
segments.description: First element of the Rover Motion Counter: the site the rover was at (flight number for Ingenuity, set number for LCAM). Values above 999 are alpha-encoded.

segments.label: Drive
segments.description: Second element of the Rover Motion Counter: the drive within the site (position for Ingenuity, instance for LCAM). Values above 9999 are alpha-encoded.

segments.label: Sequence ID
segments.description: Identifier of the command sequence the image was acquired from — or, for PIXL only, the round-trip tracking token.

segments.label: Camera specific
segments.description: Per-instrument field: Mastcam-Z focal length, SuperCam point number, SHERLOC experiment, PIXL motion counter, ECAM tile or reconstruction counter, video frame or audio clip index. The stereo partner counter is "_" on all EDRs.

segments.label: Downsample
segments.description: Downsampling applied to the image, as 2ⁿ × 2ⁿ.

segments.label: Compression
segments.description: Compression the image was downlinked with.

values.00: Thumbnail, or JPEG at unknown quality
values.I9: ICER, more than 8 bits per pixel

segments.label: Producer
segments.description: Institution or team that produced the product.

segments.label: Version
segments.description: Product version, incremented whenever an otherwise identical filename already exists. Values above 99 are alpha-encoded.

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: File format.

values.IMG: VICAR image with an attached ODL label
